title: DiBiLit-Korpus (Digitale Bibliothek, Literatur)
notes: DiBiLit is the BBAW/DTA homogenized corpus of 2,000+ texts derived from the 'Digitale Bibliothek' (DirectMedia/Zeno.org), DTABf-encoded (TEI P5 subformat), CC BY-SA 4.0, with genre folders including drama; presentation page https://www.deutschestextarchiv.de/dibilit/ (live 200). The 24 collected early German drama/Schwank texts (ayrer: Sidea, Theseus; gengenbach; opitz) match its drama files. Origin verbatim: 'DiBiLit: Sidea (ayrer, ~1600)'. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: Deutsches Textarchiv / BBAW (CLARIAH-DE, BMBF); source texts from Zeno.org / TextGrid Repository
